Why VersaCarte

One team from schematic to App Store review

Clients get firmware, API, and mobile UI under one roof — not three vendors who hand off blame. We design for intermittent power, mobile money, and mid-range devices common in East Africa.

  • End-to-end — firmware to mobile UI to cloud rules
  • Documented — architecture you can audit and hand off
  • Regional context — mobile money, power, mid-range devices
